tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures and source archive identify a plausible five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon law, while all available training rows are short-horizon. Acquire the slow-horizon discriminating probe before fitting so the possible reversal is measured.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a short-horizon stationary sink law immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five initial rows all have H ≤ 0.48 and cannot distinguish the stated dual-horizon adaptation, which may reverse around H = 15–25.
That batch is intended for the memory ODE families and is not the discriminating measurement specified for the sink-coupled dual-horizon candidate.
It does not resolve the long-horizon identifiability ambiguity.
